ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: sum of the four quarterly DPS facts 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2017-03-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: 2/4 quarters covered (the six-month year-to-date fact 2026-01-01..2026-06-30 = 547.3M (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, filed 2026-07-30)) — a lower bound
